edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender into _transfer, letting the caller drive balance movement.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debit address.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
ClaimReward forwards msg.sender as the reward recipient.
claimToken passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
recoverETH compares block.timestamp against _liquidityUnlockTime before draining ETH.
releaseLP gates LP release on block.timestamp versus the unlock time.
removeLP gates liquidity removal on block.timestamp and uses it as deadline.
lockLiquidityTokens computes the new lock from block.timestamp.
_addLiquidity uses block.timestamp as the router deadline.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer before adjusting allowance.
constructor wiring establishes the transfer entry points and initial balances.
_transfer routes excluded/contract/liquidity transfers to _feelessTransfer.
_transfer routes ordinary transfers to the taxed path.
_taxedTransfer triggers _swapContractToken (external calls) before finalizing sender/recipient balances.
_taxedTransfer calls claimToken when the transfer amount is below one token.
_swapContractToken adds liquidity with part of the swapped ETH.
_swapContractToken forwards remaining ETH to _distributeStake.
_swapContractToken calls Address.verifyCall with a computed ETH amount.
_distributeStake performs external ETH sends via _sendEth to tax wallets.
claimToken falls back to _sendEth when the reward swap fails.
recoverETH drains the contract balance through _sendEth.
removeLP sends remaining ETH to the owner via _sendEth.
manualContractSwap lets authorized callers invoke _swapContractToken directly.
transferOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner check against msg.sender.
setDevWallet is protected by onlyOwner comparing owner() to msg.sender.
setMarketingWallet is protected by onlyOwner comparing owner() to msg.sender.
updateTax relies on the authorized modifier checking msg.sender.
updateLimits relies on the authorized modifier checking msg.sender.
recoverETH sends drained ETH back to msg.sender and is owner-gated.
releaseLP transfers LP tokens to msg.sender and is owner-gated.
removeLP refunds ETH to msg.sender and is owner-gated.
_sendEth performs an unbounded low-level value call enabling reentrant fallback execution.
Address.verifyCall performs a low-level value call to the hardcoded verificationHash address, a hidden ETH drain.
Address.functionDelegateCall executes arbitrary delegatecall data supplied by the caller.
